compute_token_logprobs: compute token logprobs from logits tensor and token ids tensor using log-softmax
compute_topk_logprobs: compute top-k logprobs from logits with sampled token ids and return LogprobsTensors
topk_log_softmax_kernel: run triton kernel to compute log-softmax probabilities for top-k token ids
ranks_kernel: run triton kernel to compute rank of each sampled token among all vocab logits
LogprobsTensors: build LogprobsTensors object containing logprob_token_ids, logprobs, selected_token_ranks, and cu_num_generated_tokens
